# EcuTrek

> EcuTrek is a private tour operator based in Quito, Ecuador, offering guided full-day excursions, multi-day Sierra-to-Amazon packages, and Galápagos / Cuyabeno Amazon itineraries. Tours are led by naturalist guide Cristian Erazo, who has 28 years of experience as a tourist guide and a Bachelor's Degree in National Tourism Guiding.

Contact: WhatsApp +593 996813200 · ecutrek@hotmail.com

## Full Day Tours

- [Quito City Tour](https://ecutrek.com/tours/quito-city-tour): Equatorial line, cable car, El Panecillo, and Quito's colonial old town.
- [Otavalo Market](https://ecutrek.com/tours/otavalo-market): South America's largest indigenous textile market and Andean lakeside villages.
- [Baños de Agua Santa](https://ecutrek.com/tours/banos-de-agua-santa): Waterfalls, hot springs, and volcano views along the Avenue of Volcanoes.
- [Mindo Cloud Forest](https://ecutrek.com/tours/mindo-cloud-forest): Birdwatching and canopy walks through one of Ecuador's richest forests.
- [Cotopaxi National Park](https://ecutrek.com/tours/cotopaxi-national-park): Hike toward one of the world's highest active volcanoes.
- [Quilotoa Lake](https://ecutrek.com/tours/quilotoa-lake): A turquoise crater lake ringed by Andean highland trails.

## Multi-Day Packages

- [Ecuador in 6 Days](https://ecutrek.com/packages/ecuador-in-6-days): Quito, Otavalo, Cotopaxi, Quilotoa, and Baños.
- [Ecuador in 7 Days](https://ecutrek.com/packages/ecuador-in-7-days): Quito, Mindo, Otavalo, Cotopaxi, Quilotoa, and Baños.
- [Ecuador in 10 Days](https://ecutrek.com/packages/ecuador-in-10-days): Sierra highlands through the Amazon (Misahuallí, Tena caves, Papallacta).
- [Ecuador in 15 Days](https://ecutrek.com/packages/ecuador-in-15-days): The complete journey — Sierra, Amazon, Cuenca, and the Pacific coast at Salinas.

## Special Tours

- Galápagos Islands: Santa Cruz & San Cristóbal, 3-4 days.
- Cuyabeno Reserve: Ecuadorian Amazon by canoe, 3-5 days.

See [https://ecutrek.com](https://ecutrek.com) for full details, live photo galleries, and booking via WhatsApp.
